title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store…
description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin versions up to 4.4.6 contains an authorization flaw that allows users with access to the plugin to store popup preview data linked to arbitrary posts without proper permission checks. This flaw also permits unauthorized public access to private and draft post content, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthenticated visitors.
